subject: Mutual action plan: Private deployment kickoff — HelioHealth
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@heliohealth.com>, Ben Torres <ben.torres@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual action plan: Private deployment kickoff — HelioHealth

Hi Samira / Ben —

Thanks for the time so far. Per our conversation last week, I’m opening a short mutual action plan (MAP) thread to align owners, key milestones, and the evaluation checklist for your private/VPC deployment trial with Redwood. Goal is to have an agreed MAP and kickoff call this week so HelioHealth can start the PoC in the week of 2/21 and finish evaluation for an expected close by ~3/10.

High-level asks from today’s kickoff:
- Confirm primary technical contacts for networking (VPN/VPC), IAM/KMS, and deployment topology (on-prem vs cloud private).
- Approve the MAP timeline (draft attached) and highlight any gating items (contracts, SOC evidence, network approvals).
- Share any constraints for VPN (IP ranges, customer-managed VPN appliances) and KMS (BYOK/HSM requirements).

Proposed stakeholders (please correct/add):
- HelioHealth: Samira Khan (Sponsor), Ben Torres (Technical Lead)
- Redwood: Rishi Malhotra (Solutions Engineer, MAP owner), Lauren Bishop (Sales Director), Dev Patel (Security/Prod infra), Hiro Tanaka (Network/ops), Priya Natarajan (Deploy lead)

Attachments: MAP_HELIOHEALTH_v1.xlsx (MAP + timeline), network_topology_stub.pdf (example diagram), kms_customer_requirements.md (questionnaire). I’ve also dropped a folder with a docs checklist: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB23ExampleMapFolder

Proposed kickoff times (PST): Tues 2/16 11:00–11:45am, Wed 2/17 9:30–10:15am. If one of those works for you I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda (30–45m).

Thanks — looking forward to locking owners and next steps.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0126

Attachments: MAP_HELIOHEALTH_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), network_topology_stub.pdf (diagram), kms_customer_requirements.md (text)

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@heliohealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Torres <ben.torres@heliohealth.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: Private deployment kickoff — HelioHealth

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for pulling this together. We’re aligned on the goal and timeline; target close around 3/10 sounds right given internal approvals. I’ll own sponsorship and coordinate approvals. I’ve looped in Ben (cc’d) as our technical lead — he will drive the network and infra questions on the Helio side.

Quick answers to initial asks:
- Networking/VPN: Ben will confirm IP ranges and whether we’ll use an existing VPN appliance vs a new tunnel. We can support either, preference for site-to-site IPSec but open to transit/VPN options.
- IAM/KMS: We plan to use our existing cloud KMS (customer-managed). Need to confirm Redwood’s support for BYOK and any HSM-level requirements. Ben and I will populate the KMS questionnaire you attached.
- Timeline: We should block a 45-min kickoff on Wed 2/17 9:30am PST — that works best for our security and network teams.

Ben — can you reply here with the names of the engineers who will own VPN and IAM so we can add them to the MAP?

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Product Operations | HelioHealth
samira.khan@heliohealth.com
+1 (617) 555-8844

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@heliohealth.com>, Ben Torres <ben.torres@heliohealth.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: Private deployment kickoff — HelioHealth

Rishi — quick internal alignment.

I’ll be on the kickoff to support approvals and commercial questions. Proposed internal owners to map into the MAP spreadsheet:
- Dev Patel: Security & IAM owner (will lead KMS/BYOK discussion; will take the KMS questionnaire follow-up)
- Hiro Tanaka: Network owner (VPN topology, IP plan, connectivity testing)
- Priya Natarajan: Deployment lead (topology decisions, on-prem agent vs VPC sidecar, runtime profiling)
- Rishi: MAP owner and primary SRE contact for trial support

Target MAP milestones (draft):
- 2/17: Kickoff + owners confirmed
- 2/18–2/23: Network & KMS readiness (tunnels, firewall whitelists, KMS keys validated)
- 2/24–3/03: PoC execution (ingest sample workload, latency/cost profiling)
- 3/04–3/08: Evaluation review & regression checks (quality baselines)
- 3/10: Final decision/close (purchase order or go/no-go)

Notes: please flag if HelioHealth has any compliance audits that would require extra time (SOC evidence, retention policy reviews). I’ve summarized in the attached MAP (Rishi’s file) — we’ll keep the spreadsheet canonical in the Drive folder.

Thanks — I’ll join the 2/17 kickoff.

—Lauren
Director, Growth | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@heliohealth.com>, Ben Torres <ben.torres@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: Private deployment kickoff — HelioHealth

Thanks all — confirming the plan and owners as below so we have a single source of truth before the kickoff.

Agreed owners (final):
- HelioHealth: Samira Khan (Sponsor), Ben Torres (Technical Lead) — Ben to add VPN and KMS engineer names in reply
- Redwood: Rishi Malhotra (MAP owner), Lauren Bishop (Sales director), Dev Patel (Security/IAM), Hiro Tanaka (Network), Priya Natarajan (Deployment)

Confirmed kickoff: Wed 2/17 9:30–10:15am PST — calendar invite to follow (45m). Agenda: 1) Introductions & MAP walkthrough (10m) 2) Network & VPN constraints (10m) 3) KMS/BYOK questions (10m) 4) PoC success criteria & timeline (10m) 5) Next steps & owners (5m).

Action items before kickoff:
- Ben: please add the names/emails for your network and KMS owners and attach current VPN IP plan (CIDR ranges) — required by EOD Mon 2/15.
- Dev: please prepare a short note on Redwood’s KMS support matrix and BYOK constraints (will add to MAP doc).
- Hiro & Priya: prepare a 1-slide skim of topology options (on-prem agent vs VPC peering) for the kickoff.

I’ve uploaded the canonical MAP to the shared Drive and updated the timeline: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB23ExampleMapFolder — please use that copy for edits.

If there are other stakeholders who need access (security review, procurement), reply-all so we can add them before the call.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Original attachments referenced: MAP_HELIOHEALTH_v1.xlsx, network_topology_stub.pdf, kms_customer_requirements.md
